===Patching up Burgh De Rott===
{{Needed|At least 1 piece of [[food]] you don't mind losing (5 pieces is recommended if running past [[ghasts]] without a [[druid pouch]]), a [[pickaxe]], a [[spade]], 1-5 [[buckets]], a [[hammer]], 44 [[nail]]s, 11 [[plank]]s, 1 [[swamp paste]], 3 tinderboxes, 10 bronze axes, 10 raw mackerels or 10 snails (depending on what is asked).<br/>If [[Shades of Mort'ton]] has been completed, a hammer, planks, and swamp paste can be purchased from [[Razmire Builders Merchants]] in [[Mort'ton]] and the tinderboxes, axes, and mackerels/snails can be brought noted then sold to [[Razmire General Store]] to unnote them. If using this trick make sure you bring extra gold for the buy back process and to do it fast as the quantities deteriorate if you do not. You '''cannot''' use the general store trick as an ironman.''|recommended=[[Mort'ton teleport]] or [[fairy ring]] {{Fairycode|BIP}}}}

{{Checklist|
*Talk to [[Florin]] through the gate to [[Burgh de Rott]].
*Put a piece of food into the [[open chest (In Aid of the Myreque)|open chest]], then open the gate.
*Talk to [[Razvan]] near the pub. {{Chat option|4Are there any 'out of the way' places in here?}}
*Enter the pub, climb over the [[broken wall (Burgh de Rott)|broken wall]], then use your pickaxe on the rubble blocking the [[trapdoor (Burgh de Rott)|trapdoor]].
*Climb down and mine the rest of the [[Rubble (In Aid of the Myreque)|rubble]]. '''Anything you drop in the basement will be lost upon leaving.'''
*Use your spade on the remnants to fill the buckets. There is enough here to fill five buckets.
** Upon mining the rubble, you will find a [[plaster fragment]] and a [[Dusty scroll (In Aid of the Myreque)|dusty scroll]].
** The items dug up can be safely dropped, unless you need the [[nail]]s.
*When finished, use the buckets of rubble on the [[Rubble Pile|rubble pile]] outside the pub.
*Talk to Razvan again. {{Chat option|3I'd like to help fix up the town.}}
*Talk to [[Aurel]] in the general store to the north-east. {{Chat option|3I'd like to help fix up the town.}}
*Climb up the ladder right outside.
*Use 3 planks and 12 nails on the broken roof of the store.
*Climb back down and Use 3 planks and 12 nails on the damaged wall of the general store.
*Talk to Aurel again to get a [[Crate (In Aid of the Myreque)|crate]]. {{Chat option|3What should I do now?}}
**'''Tip:''' If you are asked for items you aren't satisfied with '''before''' receiving the crate, you can disrupt the dialogue by walking away to re-roll the requested items.
**If you weren't able to bring all of the items, head to a bank now to get the remaining items for this section.
*Add 10 [[bronze axe]]s, 10 [[raw mackerel]]s '''or''' 10 [[snail]]s (depending on what is asked), and 3 [[tinderbox]]es to the crate.
*Talk to Aurel.
*Talk to [[Cornelius]] in the bank. {{Chat option|4What should I do now?}}
*Use a hammer with 2 planks, 1 swamp paste, and 8 nails on the broken bank booth
*Use a hammer with 3 planks and 12 nails on the damaged wall outside.
*Talk to Cornelius to recruit him. {{Chat option|4}}
}}
'''You now have access to the Burgh de Rott bank.'''
